data_fields.name: mesh_merge_key_flags
data_fields.donor_constant: face direction plus material plus water flag (FaceKind::Opaque bool)

best_idea: Merge touching faces that share the same material and the same must-not-merge flags into one rectangle per row-run, so a flat zone floor or a wall becomes a few quads instead of one per tile.
decision_why: Greedy merging of static zone geometry cuts draw cost with a small, testable rule; the key must carry Frankendom's own must-not-merge flags, and the per-quad texel atlas is rejected for now because it is heavier than a browser zone needs.
acceptance: A flat 20 by 20 floor of one material is one quad in the zone mesh (a client test counts quads and asserts 1), and a shoreline cell is never merged into a land quad (the test asserts the water flag keeps them apart).
